svg.text: How the design team uses AI alongside Figma - not a replacement, an acceleration
Figma only. One tool for all design work.
Three tools chosen for the right task. Figma remains the source of truth. Speed and quality together.

All complex application design. Every project,
Think through user journeys and UX rationale faster

Paired with Figma for deeper, multi-screen products
Complex app design where UX depth matters -
Brief to working visual prototype in hours, not days
Chosen when speed matters more than UX depth
Removes scaffolding - frees designers for decisions
Websites, landing pages, microsites. Speed over
UX complexity. From brief to visual in hours.
Less time on scaffolding, more time on decisions
Designers spend less time on blank-canvas paralysis
Delivered significantly faster than traditional process
AI is a tool. Designers make every decision.
UX guidelines, accessibility standards, visual language, every design decision
Blank canvas problem, first-draft paralysis, scaffolding time
Designer's judgment is irreplaceable. AI speeds up everything around it.
"The highest value a designer brings is judgment - knowing what is right for the user.
AI accelerates everything around that judgment. It does not replace it."
